COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated monocytes and basophils. Erythrocytosis with low MCHC is present. Serum protein is low, ferritin is markedly elevated, and INR is prolonged. These findings suggest significant inflammation, possible infection or hypoxia-related stress, and a risk of coagulopathy. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
